chunks: We do not send the messengers except as bringers of good tidings and warners. So whoever believes and reforms, there will be no fear for them, nor will they grieve.
ai.seo_question: What is the purpose of sending messengers according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the mercy inherent in prophethood, where the Messenger serves as both a bearer of good news and a warner, reflecting the balance between hope and awe. The assurance of 'no fear nor grief' is interpreted as the removal of existential anxiety for those who integrate belief (Iman) with practical righteousness (Amal), a core tenet of Shia theology emphasizing the unity of faith and action.
